title.narrative: Provision of life saving protection services for drought affected internally displaced communities in Buurhakaba District, Bay Region South West state Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtltspan style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255)"gtltfont color="#333333" face="Roboto, sans-serif"gtThe proposed project by WRRS will focus on providing clinical management of rape services through training of 40 CMR (30 female and 10 male) they will be drawn from the health facilities in Buurhakaba District and will include Midwives, lt/fontgtltfont color="#333333" face="Roboto, sans-serif"gtnurses and health care workers. The trained officers will provide the CMR services to GBV survivors and victims of GBV in Buurhakaba Health facilities and other GBV one stop centres. The project will also train PSS counsellors 40 PSS Counsellors (30 female and 10 male) that will provide specialised psychosocial support and counselling through the existing GBV one stop centres and health facilities in Buurhakaba. The trained PSS counsellors will also provide referral services for services not available within the centres to other organisation operating in Buurhakaba District. WRRS will procure and distribute 1704 dignity kits to ( 1,104 women and 600 girls) the dignity kist provided will be the standard dignity kit recommended by UNFPA and as per the sphere standards. WRRS will also support the most vulnerable IDPs,Host communities and people living with Disability with cash voucher assistance , the individual women and girls will be selected based on the level of vulnerability, persons with disability, risk exposure to GBV and should be a victim or a GBV survivor, 500 beneficiaries will be selected (350 women and 150 girls). These will directly benefit from the cash transfer.Each beneficiary will get 65$. WRRS will also create awareness and outreach activities on the GBV services available in Buurhakaba, the outreach services will target 3,000 beneficiaries ( 1,100women,800 girls, 600 men and 500 boys).lt/fontgtlt/spangtltspan style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) color: rgb(51, 51, 51) font-family: Roboto, sans-serif"gtThe proposed project by WRRS targets Buurhakaba District,Bay region.
